keyFindingFixed.summary: IAM publishes the contract-mandated ApiSuccessEnvelope JWKS ({"data":{"keys":[...]}}), but all 11 domain services and service-template used the stock NimbusJwtDecoder.withJwkSetUri parser, which only accepts a bare RFC 7517 JWK Set. Real IAM access tokens were therefore rejected with 401 by every domain service; only the Gateway had an envelope-aware source.
keyFindingFixed.fix: IamEnvelopedJwkSource copied into every domain service and service-template (envelope and bare-set parsing, 5 minute TTL cache with single-flight refresh, fail-closed for empty/invalid/oversized documents, bounded java.net.http read), wired through a DefaultJWTProcessor plus JWSVerificationKeySelector decoder. The IAM contract is unchanged; the repair is on the consumer side.
keyFindingFixed.regressionTests: Each service gained IamEnvelopedJwkSourceTest (envelope/bare/invalid/empty parsing, kid selection and cache behaviour), four tests per service.

defectsFixedInThisTask: content-service ContentAuthorityAttemptFilter camelCase parameter blocklist never matched after lowercasing.
media-service rejected-header set was narrower than the baseline (5 headers) and missed workload identity/mTLS headers.
social-service SocialJwtAuthenticationConverter defaulted a missing tenant to platform instead of failing closed.
notification-service had no client authority header filter and no canonical 401/403 error envelope.
commerce-service silently stripped untrusted headers instead of rejecting them.
All domain services rejected real IAM tokens because the stock JWKS decoder cannot read the contract envelope.
notCovered: phase/consent/rights facts still come from service-side policy/PDP seams that are not yet wired (Batch 1 decision); PDP fact source remains a follow-up.
Endpoint-level fine-grained @PreAuthorize permission matrix is not applied; services enforce verified identity, tenant, role/permission presence and per-domain PEP checks.
Service-owned MySQL schemas, Flyway migrations and cross-tenant database guards remain with M2-004.
Only learning-service was exercised as a real process smoke; other services are covered by their security unit suites and the shared decoder tests.
Notification/commerce provider signature verification and durable outbound delivery remain with their later tasks.
